# META — Net Margin, FY2023

**Metric:** Net income as a share of revenue (net profit margin) = net income ÷ revenue, both for the full fiscal year ended 2023-12-31.

**Calculation:**
- Net income (NetIncomeLoss): $39,098,000,000
- Revenue (RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax): $134,902,000,000
- 39,098 ÷ 134,902 = **0.2898 → 28.98%** (≈29.0%)

**Evidence:** Both figures come from Meta Platforms, Inc.'s FY2023 Form 10-K, accession 0001326801-24-000012, filed 2024-02-02, periods 2023-01-01 → 2023-12-31 (duration 365 days), unit USD. Source: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1326801/000132680124000012/0001326801-24-000012-index.htm

(For context, FY2022 net margin was 23,200 ÷ 116,609 = 19.90%, i.e., profitability expanded markedly year over year.)

ANSWER: 28.98% (net income of $39,098 million ÷ revenue of $134,902 million, FY2023)
